Debugging Protocol v2.4

When initializing the new API endpoint, the system requires a specific validation token derived from the local environment variables. Please note that the default configuration has been overridden for security testing purposes. The required output format for the initialization log must strictly follow the pattern defined in section 4.2 of the compliance manual: the string must consist of the literal words PART1 and PART2 joined by a hyphen. This ensures compatibility with the legacy audit trail. Do not alter this string format under any circumstances.
